Allow explicit CHECK_NOW and GET_STATE requests with a private access token. Checks only work while monitoring is running. Anyone holding the token can use this access; share it only with a trusted automation app.

Optionally post status changes to independent HTTPS recipients (for example ntfy.sh topics). Each recipient has its own address, target and event filters, and delivery state. History, diagnostics and tokens are never sent; the same status is posted at most once a minute. Addresses are stored privately, excluded from backups and diagnostics, and used only after the device is unlocked. Off by default.
HTTPS only, up to 512 characters, without a login or #fragment. The saved address is not shown; enter it again to replace it.
Enter a valid https:// address without a login or #fragment.
Set a valid webhook address first.
Another request is in progress. Try again in a few seconds.

Adds fresh measured status at most every five minutes per target. No new checks or timers. Heartbeats follow status filters: OK uses Recovery; DOWN uses Unreachable; PARTIAL and No network use their matching filters. Network restored remains an event. Test messages never claim live monitoring.

Builds the HTTPS address and Text format for the selected recipient; delivery is the ordinary webhook. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. The topic and optional access token are credentials: they are stored privately and are not shown or backed up.
Enter an https:// server without a path, a topic of up to 64 letters, digits, - or _, and an optional tk_ token.

Optionally publish status changes to one MQTT 3.1.1 broker over TLS only (QoS 1, JSON payload). One short connection per message with a ten-second deadline; after failures new attempts wait 30 seconds, doubling up to 15 minutes. Nothing is queued while offline: only the latest measured state is retried later. It never changes measured status or starts monitoring. Broker, topic and credentials are stored privately, excluded from backups and diagnostics, and used only after unlock. Off by default.
TLS only. The topic cannot contain # or +. Saved values are not shown; enter them again to replace them. Username and password are optional; a password requires a username.
Enter a valid host name, port, topic without # or +, and printable credentials within the limits (a password needs a username).
Set a valid MQTT broker first.
